children.name: overview (original summary)
children.detail: OS genome scanner — every host's live vitals projected onto a 6-axis resource hexagon (cpu · mem · io · net · gpu · fs), serialized as a 60-byte genome, accumulated in a ring buffer, labeled for anomalies, and forecast 1 h ahead (Holt α/β).

children.name: overview (original summary) (cont 2)

children.name: overview (original summary) (cont 3)
children.detail: The tick loop converges as a Banach 1/3 contraction toward a stable resource fixed point — each tick maps the current resource state toward a stable fixed point at contraction factor 1/3, so the adaptive throttle settles deterministically rather than oscillating.

children.name: Tick pipeline — probe → dispatch → harvest → label → forecast
children.detail: Each tick runs a five-stage pipeline over the 6-axis hexagon.

children.name: Input
children.detail: Input = live host vitals.

children.name: Processing
children.detail: Processing = hexagon encode → ring accumulate → rule label → Holt smoothing.

children.name: Output
children.detail: Output = infra_state.json (state) + labeled_anomaly.jsonl (anomalies) + forecast.jsonl (1 h-ahead prediction).

children.name: AdaptiveThrottle
children.detail: The AdaptiveThrottle in the core contracts the tick interval toward its fixed point (Banach 1/3) based on observed load.

children.name: 1. probe
children.detail: sample Mac vitals → nexus/shared/infra_state.json. (Cross-host probing of remote Ubuntu/Hetzner was scoped out — airgenome runs mac-local only since PR #89, 2026-05-22.) · path: nexus/shared/infra_state.json

children.name: 2. dispatch
children.detail: pick the best host per workload (AG6 Mac-protect, AG7 fallback) → dispatch state.

children.name: 3. harvest
children.detail: top-N processes → 60-byte hexagon per process → forge/*.ring (ring buffer) → sigdiff deltas. · path: forge/*.ring

children.name: 4. label
children.detail: match accumulator rules → forge/labeled_anomaly.jsonl. · path: forge/labeled_anomaly.jsonl

children.name: 5. forecast
children.detail: Holt double-exponential (α / β) smoothing → 1 h-ahead → forge/forecast.jsonl. Cited delivery grade: Holt MAE 0% held-out. · path: forge/forecast.jsonl

children.name: DESIGN — design rules + decision ledger
children.detail: airgenome's live design rules (formerly @D governance blocks in the retired project.tape; identity + governance now consolidated into CLAUDE.md / README.md as the markdown governance SSOT). Append-only decision audit trail — one decision per gate, never batched, each entry's rationale ≥ 3 bullets.

children.name: Decision 1
children.detail: (1) snippet auto-input via direct CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString typing over clipboard paste — content never lands on the system clipboard;

children.name: Decision 2
children.detail: (2) register @D g_post_impl_reinstall governance entry — every artifact-affecting impl ends with `hx install airgenome`; docs-only edits exempt;

children.name: Decision 3
children.detail: (3) chase the external SIGKILL matcher before any install fallback — identify the matcher first, do NOT shortcut to make install;

children.name: Decision 4
children.detail: (4) bypass shim via fresh-copy + `exec -a hexa` (matcher isolated to an exact-path allowlist of hexa binaries);

children.name: Decision 5
children.detail: (5) ABORT decision-4's hand-rolled bypass — rely on anima §169 RATE-LIMIT-GOVERNANCE-DESIGN auto-cycle: the matcher is AppleSystemPolicy (ASP) kernel enforcement matching by binary name, and anima rotates the shim's exec target on each ASP ban,

children.name: Decision 5 (cont 2)
children.detail: so a hand-rolled copy+exec shim would race anima's writes for zero added robustness.

children.name: HUSH — macOS 부하 완화 (system load mitigation)
children.detail: Reduces CPU/battery/fan load of system daemons & background services. Auto-applied by `airgenome init` (hush step runs idempotently) or standalone `airgenome hush` (one sudo prompt; die on refusal). Implementation = bin/airgenome cmd_hush(). Env toggles: AIRGENOME_NO_HUSH · AIRGENOME_HUSH_NOSUDO.
